.. _user_guide:

********************
OCF_Tools User Guide
********************

.. currentmodule:: ocf_tools

.. sectionauthor:: Scott A. Socolofsky

OCF_Tools is a Python package for making commoon open-channel hydraulics calculations.  

Module User Guides
------------------

OCF_Tools is organized into separate modules, with each module focused on a different application.  These are summarized in the following table, with their relevant user guide linked in the Description and User Guide column (if availabel):

=====================   ==============================
Module                  Description and User Guides
=====================   ==============================
``ocf_tools``           :doc:`./ocf_tools`
``culvert_tools``       :doc:`./culvert_tools`
``storage_routing``     :doc:`./storage_routing`
=====================   ==============================
